text.text: Plan every post, email and video in one place. Start on the calendar, drag nothing, just open a piece and set its date.
Content
Open any piece to find a brief (audience, angle, outline, call to action) already inside it.
Channels
Needs attention
Coming up
Fifteen minutes each Monday keeps the month honest.
Every scheduled piece has an author and a date
Nothing is stuck in editing for more than three days
One idea is promoted to a draft
Check each channel against its weekly goal
This week
Run through this list for every piece, every time. The most expensive mistakes (a broken link, the wrong date, a missing image) are all on it.
Title and first line read well on their own
Images have descriptions
Links open and go where they should
Preview looks right on a phone
Published address pasted back into the piece
After publishing
Share once on each social channel
Move the status to Published
Note anything to change next time
